name: skills
one_liner: Anthropic's official, free collection of example instruction packs that teach Claude how to do specific jobs, like editing documents or building websites, plus the template for writing your own.
buyer: A solo operator or small agency that wants to build a niche AI-assisted service (e.g. document formatting, branded content creation) without paying a developer to build the underlying capability from scratch.
business_use_cases: A virtual-assistant agency uses the docx/pdf/pptx skills as the engine behind a 'AI-formatted document' service sold to small businesses.
A freelance developer studies the example skills as templates to build and sell a custom skill for a specific industry (e.g. legal contract review) via skill marketplaces.
A consultant uses this repo as a training reference when teaching corporate clients how to build their own internal Claude skills.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a niche, polished skill (industry-specific templates, brand-compliant documents) that goes beyond what's in the example repo.
Offer a 'skills audit and build' consulting service for companies that want custom Claude skills but don't have in-house AI expertise.

steal_this: Pick one under-served example skill (e.g. a niche document type) and turn it into a paid, better-documented, drop-in skill sold on a skills marketplace this weekend.
